content_blocks.heading_text: Project Management Careers in the Permian Basin

The Permian Basin operational expansions by ConocoPhillips and ExxonMobil, along with major infrastructure work at Midland International Air and Space Port and Midland Memorial Hospital's facility expansion projects, demonstrate the scale and frequency of capital-intensive work underway locally. These initiatives require disciplined project delivery, and employers increasingly seek candidates who can demonstrate certified competency in standardized methodologies.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Midland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the experience and education thresholds. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify requirements specific to your background before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our structured curriculum covers the PMBOK® Guide domains and exam strategy over intensive sessions. You'll earn the required formal-education contact hours and develop hands-on project-management skills applicable to Midland's energy and construction sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the boot camp, submit your PMI certification application directly to the Project Management Institute. Document your project-management experience, pay the PMI exam fee, and await PMI's review and approval. Our team provides guidance on application documentation to ensure accuracy.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy supplies exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor support to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll sit for a proctored, computer-based exam that evaluates your mastery of project-management processes and best practices.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification remains valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, and professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to help you sustain your credential and advance your project-management career in Midland.
